def build_strokes(grid=30):
    target = np.asarray(Image.open(TARGET).convert('RGB'))
    small = np.asarray(Image.fromarray(target).resize((grid,grid), Image.Resampling.BOX), dtype=np.float64)
    t_lab = rgb_to_lab(small)
    p_lab = rgb_to_lab(PALETTE_RGB)

    label = dist.argmin(axis=2)
    strokes = [[] for _ in range(16)]

        col = 0

            paint = int(label[row,col])
            end = col
            while end+1 < grid and int(label[row,end+1]) == paint:
                end += 1

            v = (row + .5) / grid
